Potential_Fragceylon_Use: Classify future orders into broad Low, Medium or High demand categories.
Main_Advantage: Simple probabilistic classifier with direct class probabilities.
Main_Limitation: Quantity must be categorized, causing substantial information loss; conditional-independence assumption is also strong.
Current_Assessment: Useful only as an optional coarse classification view. Holdout accuracy = 0.3687.

Potential_Fragceylon_Use: Estimate continuous Quantity while incorporating prior information and updating uncertainty as new data arrive.
Main_Advantage: Produces posterior distributions and can incorporate previous knowledge or expert information.
Main_Limitation: Requires defensible priors, more statistical expertise and usually more computational work than ordinary regression.
Current_Assessment: Potentially useful, but generic prior sensitivity gives performance close to the existing Reduced MLR. Best illustrative prior RMSE = 137.9497.

Potential_Fragceylon_Use: Combine predictive probabilities with the business costs of excess stock, stock-outs, shipping and missed sales.
Main_Advantage: Connects uncertainty directly to business actions and consequences.
Main_Limitation: Requires credible cost/loss values and posterior predictive distributions; current dataset does not contain full inventory-cost information.
Current_Assessment: Conceptually highly relevant for inventory decisions, but exact action recommendations should wait until real stock-out, holding, shipping and margin costs are available.
